question: en § 5 and nen pr converge: a sub-PR into an integration branch that closes no issue makes converge exit 1 (cannot tell what it closes). HA-PR-#456 reads that case as not applicable so readiness can proceed, but a reading may not authorise a merge path (HR-3). Rule it?

options.label: Rule it (Recommended)
options.consequence: A non-default-base PR with no closing row is not applicable for criterion coverage; readiness and the recorded delivery merge proceed on the other conjuncts

options.label: Hand to me
options.consequence: Such a PR never merges by an agent; en hands it to the merge prompt and the maintainer decides each time
